name: Kozhikode Bakery Trail
description: Three bakery listings grouped around central Kozhikode. Start with Cochin Bake House and work north toward Regal Bakes.

name: Bengaluru Iyengar Bakery Run
description: Follow three listings with Iyengar bakery in their names across Bengaluru, from the south of the city toward the east.

name: Kochi Bakery Run
description: A short list of saved bakeries for exploring greater Kochi, starting with Best Bakers and ending at Dhanya Bakery.
